name: color_combination
notes: Theme color presets applied on sections. o_cc1 is the plain base background; o_cc2 a light tinted background; o_cc3 and o_cc4 stronger emphasis backgrounds; o_cc5 the boldest (often dark or saturated). Alternate combinations between adjacent sections to create rhythm; use o_cc3/o_cc4/o_cc5 sparingly, for sections that deserve emphasis (hero, call-to-action). All presets are contrast-safe by construction.

entries.desc: Plain base background, the default reading surface
Light tinted background, subtle alternation with o_cc1
Boldest preset, often dark or saturated; heroes and CTAs
